proposal: Remove manuallyPaused-without-queue rejection; paused+stop_when_ready and auto_managed false for queuePolicy or manuallyPaused; resume checking for either; explicit nonpolicy manual resume unsets stop_when_ready before resuming.
scope: Valid managed metadata and ordinary checking, without seed-mode/no_verify_files shortcut. Readiness transition pauses synchronously before ordinary tracker announce or outgoing/incoming payload admission.
caveat: connect_peer enqueues candidate; add_peer can add a session DHT node when session DHT is enabled. stop_when_ready is not a universal no-network guarantee. Isolated session disables DHT.
